scope: Exactly four workflows on main: two schedule delegates, focused bridge validation, and staging push-path protection. No application source, broker, frozen strategy or deployment image is changed by this review.
findings: Both delegates retain their existing UTC schedules and manual dispatch and pin both reusable workflow revision and source_sha to the same full 0d1c93d SHA.
Delegates supply no inherited secrets and request contents:read plus issues:write for the already-authorized automatic failure issue behavior.
The focused contract checks exact triggers/permissions/inputs, remote reusable target existence and pinned checkout, same source for both delegates, and the narrow staging exclusion.

Staging push.paths-ignore contains exactly the four changed workflow paths. Bridge-only merges skip this old-main staging pipeline; a push containing backend/build/dependency changes remains eligible. Existing explicit labeled and manual triggers are preserved.

The three bridge-owned workflows receive strict actionlint validation. Staging candidate diagnostics are compared with the PR base; its four existing diagnostics are retained explicitly, with no new signature accepted.

validation.checkout_note: The hosted pull_request checkout reports its synthetic merge SHA; run metadata identifies the reviewed PR head.
validation.reviewer_mutations: Only this review artifact; no main source edits, merge or deployment.

conditional_acceptance_gates: Require successful actual post-close audit of pinned source 0d1c93d, including truthful full-pack/KPI/status artifacts, plus accepted source safety evidence before activating the bridge.
Retain required branch-protection/PR acceptance decisions without representing unrelated old-main checks as green or silently bypassing them.
After any authorized merge, verify the real scheduled run audited source SHA and uploaded evidence. The focused contract pass is not proof that a future cron execution has occurred.
Update both workflow pins together through review for later source changes; preserve final evidence and no-secret-change verification.
explicit_baselines_and_limits: Old-main CI Quality Gates (lint, type, security, test/coverage and Quality Summary) remain failed in the current PR run; this review neither fixes nor certifies them.

The unchanged old-main secret-scan job fails. Its recursive literal grep matches its own sk_live pattern; it is not represented as a clean scanner result or as proof of a new credential in this four-file diff. No credential literal was introduced by the reviewed diff.

Four preexisting staging actionlint diagnostics remain: two obsolete setup-python action uses, one obsolete codecov action, and an undefined needs.test reference. Preserving their baseline does not certify staging deploy readiness.
paths-ignore protects this staging push workflow only; explicit manual/labeled staging triggers remain available.
Scheduled evidence runs isolated against the pinned operational source, not old main, and does not itself observe the local broker/runtime.
No accounting activation, historical-state change, forward-clock reset, strategy promotion or real-money action is approved.
